title: Milwaukee, WI — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Milwaukee, WI: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Milwaukee is a city in WI with a population of 561,385. Brew City on Lake Michigan with summer festivals, cheap housing, and cheese curds. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.2.
